baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah places ءَامَنُوا at word 4 and أَمْنًا at word 26, turning one root from the community's disposition into its promised condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settled trust is carried through intentional, reparative work into a public state where expected harm no longer governs action; undivided worship names what that security is for.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settled assent supplies the addressed community's starting trust and shares one root with the promised outcome.
Calm, trustworthiness, and freedom from fear supply the concrete social state into which belief is converted.
Purposive action makes the transition depend on enacted practice rather than nominal affiliation.
Repair opposed to corruption gives those actions their world-mending direction.
Expected harm is the prior governing condition that the promised security displaces.
Obedient, humbled service gives the secured condition its continuing purpose.
The negated partnership image excludes any co-owner from the community's ultimate service.

changed_reading.before: Believers who do good are rewarded with safety.
changed_reading.after: Trusted assent is converted through intended repair into a shared condition of safety, and that safety exists to make undivided service practicable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence وعد، يستخلفنهم، كما استخلف، من قبلهم، يبدلنهم، من بعد خوفهم، وبعد ذلك builds a chain of before, replacement, and accountable after.
baseline_models.mechanism: The promise is not a static grant: one collectivity takes the place of another by precedent, fear is replaced by security, and a new post-gift threshold opens in which response still matters.

activation_trace.role: A spoken commitment opens expectation while retaining the polarity of fulfillment or breach.
Coming after and standing in another's place supplies the core replacement relation.
Alternating succession makes the two uses of استخلف a repeatable temporal pattern, not an isolated accession.
Prior peoples furnish an anterior stage and visible precedent.
One condition taking another's place makes security an actual substitution for fear.
The doubled after marks both the move beyond fear and the later moral exposure beyond the gift.

changed_reading.before: The ayah predicts that believers will gain power and then be safe.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a precedent-bearing succession, a real exchange of conditions, and a post-gift test; installation is temporal and accountable rather than a timeless blank check.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ and وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُم join spatial emplacement, capability, and the approved mode of obedience.
baseline_models.mechanism: Succession supplies occupants, earth supplies a cultivable place, and تمكين supplies both location and effective capacity; the approved dīn therefore becomes a stable practice that can inhabit and shape a shared world.

activation_trace.role: Standing in another's place supplies the social occupants of the promised order.
Fertile, well-rooted earth contributes a place capable of receiving durable growth, not bare territory alone.
A place of being makes establishment spatial and inhabitable.
Effective capacity adds the ability to operate, not merely permission to exist.
Obedience and practiced submission identify what is made operative in that place.
Acceptance rather than displeasure qualifies this order as selected and approved, not self-authorized.

changed_reading.before: God will make the believers' religion dominant in the land.
changed_reading.after: God will give an approved mode of obedience a stable habitat and practical capacity, with the believers installed as its responsible occupants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly produces safety by controlling permeability: entry begins with a peace-bearing approach, access requires permission, vulnerable boundaries are guarded, and private zones remain covered. أَمْنًا thus becomes a civic privacy architecture, not only relief from an external enemy.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust remain the focus outcome whose mechanism the context sharpens.
Wholeness free of harm gives the greeting at an entrance a safety-making function.
Permission makes another household's boundary traversable only by authorized access.
Active guarding supplies the maintenance work by which vulnerable boundaries remain secure.
The concealed private zone supplies what regulated looking and access are designed to protect.

structural_cues: 24:27-31 moves from entering houses to permission, lowered gaze, and guarded exposure; 24:58-61 later differentiates private times, access, and peaceful entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permission, guarding, concealment, and peace-bearing entry; I infer that these practices causally build the promised security. A live alternative is that they merely exemplify neighboring household etiquette while أَمْنًا remains chiefly geopolitical.

changed_reading.before: Security is a broad public end state after fear.
changed_reading.after: Security is also an actively maintained order of consent, guarded boundaries, and protected privacy through which people can inhabit shared space without predation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Within the surah, dīn participates both in obedience and in a fully rendered account, while حق marks a binding due and حكم adjudicates between people. تمكين الدين can therefore denote capacity for an approved norm of obedience and accountability to function publicly.

activation_trace.role: Obedience and practiced submission provide the focus sense that is established.
Account and recompense activate an accountability register within the same root elsewhere in the surah.
Full rendering without deficiency makes that account something completed rather than vaguely asserted.
A binding due and deserved claim give the account a normative, enforceable edge.
Judgment between people supplies the public procedure through which an accountable order operates.

structural_cues: 24:2 places dīn beside a public legal sanction; 24:25 couples dīn with full rendering and truth; 24:48-51 tests response to adjudication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obedience, recompense, binding right, and adjudication; I infer that their recurrence lets dīn in 24:55 carry an institutional accountability overlay. The materially live alternative is strict polysemy: 24:25 may mean recompense without coloring the religious sense in 24:55.

changed_reading.before: Their religion receives freedom or dominance.
changed_reading.after: Their approved obedience gains the capacity to operate as an accountable public norm, including judgment and the faithful rendering of what is due.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate lead-in contrasts verbal profession with turning away from judgment, names obedient response, and assigns carried burdens; the immediate follow-up commands maintained prayer, alms, and obedience. Succession is thereby commissioned office sustained by enacted obligations, not possession secured by identity alone.

activation_trace.role: Standing in another's place supplies the focus relation that the context recasts as responsibility.
Turning away after a verbal profession supplies the failed contrast to responsible installation.
Responsive obedience supplies the conduct that distinguishes an entrusted community from a merely self-named one.
Bearing an entrusted load makes both messenger and community answerable for assigned obligations.
Rising to and maintaining an undertaking turns the post-promise prayer command into continuing institutional work.

structural_cues: 24:47-54 directly precedes the promise with profession, adjudication, obedience, and apportioned burdens; 24:56 directly follows it with maintained prayer, alms, and obedience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning away, responsive obedience, entrusted burdens, and maintenance immediately around the focus; I infer that these define how succession is held. An alternative is that they are qualifications and consequences of a reward rather than the internal mechanism of office.

changed_reading.before: Believers replace previous powers and receive secure possession.
changed_reading.after: Believers are installed as entrusted stand-ins whose tenure is enacted by bearing obligations and maintaining worship and social dues; succession is conditional stewardship, not unconditional ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accusation sequence models insecurity as an information process: a report is turned away from truth, carried by a mutually supporting group, received under suspicion, poured into circulation, and allowed to spread. Because إيمان and أمن share the focus root, disciplined reception of speech becomes one path from inward trust to social safety.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settled trust provides the receptive posture whose social consequences are tested by circulating reports.
Public trust and freedom from fear provide the outcome damaged or restored by speech practices.
Falsehood diverted from truth supplies the initiating distortion.
A group that surrounds and reinforces itself supplies the social carrier of the distortion.
Bad suspicion is the live reception mode displaced by the commanded good assumption.
Speech spreading like an outflow supplies the transmission mechanism.
Diffusion and dispersal supply the scale-up from report to community-wide harm.

structural_cues: 24:11-20 traces a compact faction, communal reception, tongue-to-mouth transmission, diffusion, and painful consequence before returning to mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distortion, group reinforcement, suspicion, flow, and diffusion; I infer a causal chain from corrupt circulation to fear and from truthful restraint to security. The alternative is that this sequence concerns one legal vindication and should not define the broader promised أَمْنًا.

changed_reading.before: Fear and security concern overt coercion or external threat.
changed_reading.after: Security also names a trustworthy speech ecology in which reports cannot be inverted, group-amplified, and diffused into reputational fear; inward belief becomes mutual credit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's post-gift covering and shell-exit are sharpened by later images of layered covering, slipping out, hiding behind others, and taking a path contrary to command. The final warning describes not only a belief label but a practical movement out of a visible, shared obligation.

activation_trace.role: Covering a received benefit makes post-gift kufr an act of obscuring or denying the promised transformation.
A ripe date leaving its shell supplies a concrete boundary-exit image for the resulting condition.
A covering laid over something supplies the surah's layered obscuration pattern against the nearby light imagery.
Slipping out supplies the covert motion by which shared presence is abandoned.
Using another as cover supplies the social concealment that enables the exit.
Taking a path other than the command supplies the oppositional direction of the departure.

structural_cues: 24:39-40 opposes empty or covered works to divinely given light; 24:62-63 opposes permission within a gathering to covert departure from it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, covert withdrawal, concealment behind others, مخالفة, and a shell-exit image; I infer a cover-to-exit pathway for the focus warning. A live alternative is that 24:63 addresses assembly discipline independently and that فاسقون remains a general verdict.

changed_reading.before: Whoever disbelieves after the blessing is generically sinful.
changed_reading.after: Post-gift kufr can be read as covering the manifested benefit and covertly exiting its shared obligations; fusuq pictures departure from the protective order rather than a static label alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The light passage moves from illumination into raised houses and repeated practices that commerce does not interrupt. This gives تمكين a visible and rhythmic mechanism: approved obedience becomes housed, publicly marked, and maintained through time.

activation_trace.role: A place of being anchors the focus establishment in a stable social location.
Practiced obedience identifies what receives that stable location.
Illumination supplies public legibility and orientation rather than concealed existence.
Dwelling and shelter give the light-bearing practice an inhabitable social container.
Raising makes those houses and their practice manifest and sustained.
Rising to an undertaking gives repeated prayer its maintained, non-interrupted rhythm.

structural_cues: 24:35-37 moves from light to houses to morning-evening practice and economic non-distraction; 24:39-40 then contrasts works that prove mirage-like or covered in darkness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies illumination, houses, elevation, and maintained practice; I infer that they show how an approved dīn becomes socially visible and durable. The alternative is that the light-and-houses sequence is devotional imagery without institutional force for تمكين in 24:55.

changed_reading.before: Establishment means that religion is protected or politically ascendant.
changed_reading.after: Establishment also means that approved obedience becomes visible, housed, and rhythmically durable in ordinary social and economic life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain meteorological analogy, not a claim that succession lexically means cloud formation. It remains anchored in the focus's earth, replacement, and regenerative خ ل ف branch, while 24:43 supplies joining, accumulation, and state-change; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory process image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يستخلفنهم في الأرض، يبدلنهم permits a process reading of collective replacement within an earth repeatedly shown receiving assembled weather.

activation_trace.role: Growth or provision returning after prior loss supplies a regenerative rather than merely dynastic image of succession.
Fertile, well-rooted earth provides the receiving field for that regenerative process.
Change of condition without requiring a new substance permits transformation of a community's social form.
Joining separate elements supplies a model for collective formation.
Accumulation layer upon layer supplies the threshold at which a dispersed collective becomes effective.
Turning from one state to another supplies the process arrow from fear-conditioned dispersion to secure formation.

changed_reading.before: Succession is a completed swap between ruling groups.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, succession can be pictured as regenerative collective formation: dispersed elements are joined and accumulated until the same social body changes condition and becomes life-giving in the earth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation depends on the packet's split mapping from و ع د to ع د د and is therefore form-distant; it must not be rendered as a lexical gloss of وَعَدَ. It remains anchored at the opening promise, the focus's purposeful work, and the adjacent burden language, so it is worth carrying as a qualified performative echo: the pledge readies its hearers for work.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَعَدَ opens the ayah before the qualifications of faith and purposeful صالح work and before three emphatic future acts.

activation_trace.role: Preparation, equipment, and stored readiness provide the packet-authorized but form-distant echo that a promise can mobilize capacity.
Intentional action keeps the readiness image tied to enacted qualification rather than passive expectation.
Exerting full capacity under difficulty supplies the nearby contrast between emphatic verbal pledge and actual readiness.
Bearing an entrusted load identifies the practical capacity for which the community is readied.

changed_reading.before: The promise only reports what God will later give.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, the promise also prepares and mobilizes its recipients for the entrusted work of the future it announces.

strongest_changes: The doubled ء م ن moved from a simple reward sequence to a conversion of inward trust into public safety maintained through consent, guarded boundaries, and disciplined speech.
دِينَهُم moved from protected creed alone to an approved, accountable public norm activated by full rendering, binding right, and adjudication.
استخلاف moved from possession or regime replacement to entrusted, obligation-bearing stewardship sustained by recurring practice.
The closing كفر/فسق warning became a dynamic of covering a manifested gift and covertly exiting its shared obligations.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah's own trust-to-security root repetition and before/replacement/after grammar became a hub through which the whole surah's household access rules, rumor circulation, adjudication, light-bearing houses, burdens, and covert departure generated several coexisting readings without requiring one final synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The domestic access material may be a causal mechanism of promised security or only a neighboring legal exemplification.
The account/recompense sense of د ي ن in 24:25 may legitimately color 24:55, or the two senses may need to remain sharply distinct.
The cloud-cycle and وعد-to-عدة activations are useful exploratory mechanisms but should not be promoted into lexical claims.
The ayah itself does not settle the political scale, duration, or reversibility of the promised installation.
